bot.welcome: Welcome! Send a supported track or album link. For a track, choose Download or another quality. For an album, download all tracks or select a subset. On your first download, you’ll choose a default quality; you can change it later with /quality.
bot.help: Send a supported track or album URL. Track Cards offer Download and one-off quality; Album Cards offer Download all, track selection, and one-off album quality. Use /quality to change the default for future requests and /language to change the interface language. Playlists are not supported.
